name: Проклятие! Смена расы
alt: Дварф рассматривает выросшие эльфийские уши, но расстаться с большими сапогами не готов.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, readable at 384 by 384 pixels. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink outlines, loose watercolor and gouache on warm parchment, colorful accents. One obvious visual joke, simple chunky shapes, minimal background, centered large subject with comfortable margins. Modest detail, no intricate scenery. No text, letters, digits, logos, watermark, border or card frame. Clear anatomy, no extra limbs. Subject: An adult bearded fantasy dwarf looks at his unexpectedly long pointed elf ears in a little hand mirror while his oversized boots remain stubbornly dwarven. One hand holds mirror, other touches one ear, exactly two arms. Friendly identity-changing magic, no mockery.
